newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's former health minister questioned.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's former health minister questioned.

text.p: South Korea's former health minister Lee Sung-ho appeared at the Seoul district prosecutor's office for questioning on Wednesday, a prosecution official said.
The official, who declined to be named, gave no further details. Lee had stepped down earlier in the day in a bribery scandal involving his wife.
Earlier, the presidential Blue House issued a statement saying Lee had resigned "because his wife was suspected of taking bribes".

State-run Korea Broadcasting System quoted unnamed prosecutors as saying Lee's wife, Park Sung-ae, was summoned for questioning on Tuesday night and had confessed to accepting 160 million won ($193,000) from an opticians' trade group.
